prompt: What are the most recent events that you know about before your training cutoff?
judge_reasoning: Candidate 2 directly answers the prompt by listing multiple specific, plausibly correct recent events occurring before its stated cutoff (early 2023 and late 2022). Candidate 3 is also on-topic and mostly accurate but gives fewer, more general items and includes less “recent” relevance compared to candidate 2. Candidate 4 contains clear factual problems and also includes an event not actually completed before the (assumed) cutoff (e.g., “set to hold” the 2024 election), so it is less reliable. Candidate 1 mostly refuses to provide recent events and instead offers general categories, failing to deliver the requested specifics.
